_doc: Product pages for haven.amni-scient.com. Image paths are relative to ~/ai. Groups become sidebar categories in this order. Read by amniScientLayout.js.

products.name: Amni-OS
products.tagline: Leave Windows without learning a shell. Arch + Plasma 6 with a Start menu, Steam, Wine, local AI and Amni-Browse.

features.name: A desktop that feels familiar
features.desc: Start menu, bottom bar, folders, printers and NTFS drives work the way you expect.

features.name: Control
features.desc: Drivers, updates, printers and colours in one panel.

features.name: Guided installer
features.desc: A branded installer that walks you through it.

features.name: Games and local AI
features.desc: Steam, Proton, Wine and Lutris, plus Ollama with one-click GPU setup.

features.name: Restore and apps
features.desc: Snapshots you can boot from GRUB; Discover, Flathub and distroboxes for apps.

products.name: Amni-Core
products.tagline: A from-scratch, GPU-forward OS with a frosted-glass desktop that runs real Windows, Linux and macOS programs natively.

features.name: Frosted-glass desktop
features.desc: UEFI boot straight to a GPU-composited desktop.

features.name: Universal binaries
features.desc: PE, ELF and Mach-O run on the kernel, no VM.

features.name: Built from zero
features.desc: Its own bootloader, kernel, drivers and window system.

features.name: Modern crypto and integrity
features.desc: ChaCha20-Poly1305 and an integrity-checked boot.

products.name: Amni-Connect
products.tagline: End-to-end encrypted remote desktop: WebRTC peer-to-peer streaming, self-hostable signalling. No cloud, no accounts.

features.name: Browser viewer
features.desc: Control a machine from any browser, nothing to install.

features.name: Custom room codes and clipboard sync
features.desc: Ephemeral rooms and two-way clipboard.

features.name: End-to-end encrypted
features.desc: DTLS-SRTP; the signalling server never sees a frame.

features.name: Self-hostable signalling
features.desc: A small Node server on any VPS, Pi or LAN box.

features.name: Adaptive quality
features.desc: Bitrate follows the link, with a signal indicator.

products.name: Amni-Browse
products.tagline: A privacy-first, zero-telemetry browser in a single Rust binary on the Servo engine. Ad blocker, private tabs, profiles.

features.name: Zero telemetry
features.desc: It only contacts the pages you navigate to.

features.name: Built-in ad blocker
features.desc: Ads, pixels and fingerprinting blocked at the navigation layer.

features.name: Bring your own vault
features.desc: AES-256 vault plus Bitwarden, 1Password and KeePassXC autofill.

features.name: Private tabs and profiles
features.desc: No persistent history, tracking parameters stripped, isolated profiles.

products.name: Amni-Space
products.tagline: Maps a whole Windows drive in about 20 seconds from the NTFS $MFT, then helps you clean it up safely.

features.name: Two ways to look
features.desc: Nested treemap or sunburst, coloured by type, age or size.

features.name: Finds the fat
features.desc: Caches, build output, duplicates and the biggest files.

features.name: An AI that asks first
features.desc: A local or cloud model proposes a plan; nothing happens until you approve.

features.name: Nothing vanishes
features.desc: Deletes go to the Recycle Bin and every run can be undone.

products.name: Amni-AI
products.tagline: Adam: a local, self-improving AI assistant. Runs in about 4 GB of VRAM, remembers corrections, speaks the Ollama/OpenAI API.

features.name: HUD dashboard
features.desc: Voice, sessions and skills at a glance.

features.name: Chat that streams locally
features.desc: Local chat with maths and diagram rendering.

features.name: Socratic coach
features.desc: A coach mode that asks you the questions.

features.name: Live widgets
features.desc: System stats and live data at a glance.

products.name: Braid
products.tagline: Claude, Grok, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor and a local model in one room. Ask once; they answer together.

features.name: All at once
features.desc: The same question to every seat in parallel, compared blind.

features.name: One at a time
features.desc: Each seat reads the last and extends, pushes back or fixes it.

features.name: Squads
features.desc: Builders against attackers at the same table.

features.name: Your accounts, not a token meter
features.desc: Uses the CLIs you already signed into.

features.name: Permissions per seat
features.desc: Plan, Edit or Bypass: set each seat's rights before the round.

products.name: Amni-Code
products.tagline: An agentic coding assistant in a single Rust binary. Any LLM provider, or your existing Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or Cursor plan.

features.name: Agentic tool loop
features.desc: Reads, writes and runs on its own for up to 15 iterations.

features.name: Any provider
features.desc: Adam, Gemini, Grok, GPT, Claude, Ollama, or your subscription.

features.name: Integrated terminal
features.desc: Runs builds, tests and git, and feeds the output back.

features.name: Diffs and history
features.desc: Highlighted diffs and a persistent chat.

products.name: Amni-LLM
products.tagline: Load any GGUF model from Hugging Face right in the browser. Built-in search, one-click install, WebLLM-compatible API.

features.name: Hugging Face search
features.desc: Search live, pick a quant, load it.

features.name: Fully client-side
features.desc: WASM inference; nothing goes to a server.

features.name: Local files
features.desc: Drop a .gguf in from disk.

features.name: WebLLM-compatible API
features.desc: chatCompletions.create and chatStream() work as-is.

products.name: Grok-Remote
products.tagline: A live phone cockpit for Grok Build. Pair with one QR, watch thinking and tool calls stream live, run many sessions.

features.name: Live stream, not a transcript
features.desc: Thinking, tool calls and the answer arrive as they happen.

features.name: Organised sessions
features.desc: Sessions filed by where they came from.

features.name: Pair with one QR
features.desc: Scan once for a 30-day key; every request is key-gated.

features.name: Skills a tap away
features.desc: Every installed skill in a slash palette.

products.name: Amni-Haven
products.tagline: The native Android client for Haven: real-time chat, push, voice, video, screen share and encrypted DMs.

features.name: Real-time chat
features.desc: Live messages and typing indicators.

features.name: Channels
features.desc: A channel sidebar with unread badges.

features.name: Any Haven server
features.desc: Connect to any self-hosted Haven with an invite code.

features.name: Voice, video and encrypted DMs
features.desc: Peer-to-peer calls and end-to-end encrypted direct messages.

products.name: Symphony
products.tagline: A private, end-to-end encrypted app for family and community: feeds, chat, calls, photos, stories and polls. No account.

features.name: A feed, not an algorithm
features.desc: Your people's posts, no ads, no ranking.

features.name: Chat, calls and rooms
features.desc: Group and 1:1 chat, voice, video and screen share.

features.name: Stories and polls
features.desc: 24-hour stories, polls and swipe-to-reply.

features.name: End-to-end encrypted
features.desc: The relay can't read anything.

features.name: Make it yours
features.desc: Whole-app themes and wallpapers.

products.name: Amni-Mail
products.tagline: A local-first Outlook replacement: mail, threads, calendar, contacts and rules. Your mail stays on your machine.

features.name: Mail
features.desc: Unified inbox, threads, search and rules.

features.name: Clean review
features.desc: Adam proposes a cleanup; you review it, with undo.

features.name: Subscriptions
features.desc: One-click unsubscribe.

features.name: Calendar
features.desc: Month grid, .ics invites and RSVP.

products.name: HedgeDoc
products.tagline: An unofficial native Android client for HedgeDoc 1.x and 2. Connect to the server you already run.

features.name: HedgeDoc 1.x and 2
features.desc: History, create, edit, pin, delete and revisions.

features.name: Your login, your cookies
features.desc: Local, LDAP, guest, cookie or API token; no phone-home.

features.name: Scient themes
features.desc: Twelve Amni-Scient palettes plus Light.

products.name: Amni-Type
products.tagline: An Android keyboard that swipes, predicts and corrects entirely on your phone. No telemetry, no cloud, no account.

features.name: Swipe on-device
features.desc: Full-vocabulary glide typing scored on the phone.

features.name: Look and feel
features.desc: Haptics, swipe trail and key gap, your way.

features.name: Zero telemetry
features.desc: The dictionary and language model never leave the phone.

products.name: Amni-Crypt
products.tagline: File encryption for Android built on a 1024-bit, 16-round block cipher with HMAC-SHA512 tamper detection.

features.name: 1024-bit blocks
features.desc: A block cipher over a 16x16 grid, 16 rounds.

features.name: Tamper detection
features.desc: HMAC-SHA512 verifies every file.

features.name: Cipher seal and QR
features.desc: A visual certificate you can verify by QR.

products.name: Amni-Explore
products.tagline: A WebGL space game: an 80,000-particle galaxy with NASA exoplanet data, a rocket engineering lab and colonies.

features.name: A galaxy you can fly
features.desc: 80,000 particles with spiral arms, from galaxy scale down to a single system.

features.name: Real exoplanets
features.desc: 500 NASA exoplanets among 3,000+ systems.

features.name: Planet detail
features.desc: 3D planets with tilt, moons, atmosphere and data.

features.name: Rocket engineering lab
features.desc: Build rockets part by part, then launch them.

products.name: Amni-Calc
products.tagline: A free in-browser engineering calculator suite: 37 modules from FEA and bolts to fluids, HVAC and electrical.

features.name: Fasteners and seals
features.desc: Bolt torque and preload, springs, O-ring glands.

features.name: Reference library
features.desc: Materials database and surface finishes.

features.name: Fluids and thermal
features.desc: Moody/Colebrook, pump NPSH, heat transfer, cycles.

features.name: Stress and structural
features.desc: Mohr's circle, beams, columns, shafts and welds.

features.name: Electrical
features.desc: 3-phase, NEC ampacity, electrochemistry, battery sizing.

products.name: Amni-Learn
products.tagline: Privacy-first learning for every age: Pre-K tracing, K-12 maths, reading and STEM, adult brain games. 71 games.

features.name: Tracing
features.desc: Letters, numbers, shapes and cursive with stroke guidance.

features.name: Brain gym
features.desc: Sudoku, puzzles and cards for adults.

features.name: Maths and life skills
features.desc: Arithmetic, word problems, clocks, money and music.

features.name: Private by design
features.desc: Everything stays on the device, with a printable daily packet.

products.name: Amni-Weather
products.tagline: Interactive weather maps in the browser: live fields, point forecasts, NWS and GDACS hazards, a Rust/WASM engine.

features.name: Map layers
features.desc: Temperature, dew point, precipitation, pressure, wind, CAPE, UV and more.

features.name: Point forecast
features.desc: Drop a pin for now, hourly, 7-day, surf and air quality.

features.name: Hazards
features.desc: NWS and GDACS alerts on the map.

products.name: Amni-Game
products.tagline: A bolt-sized robot sets out to bring colour back to thirteen realms. Play in the browser; saves stay on your device.

features.name: Thirteen realms
features.desc: Find the canvases, beat the tyrants, repaint the world.

features.name: A hub world to explore
features.desc: Every realm branches from the glade.

features.name: Boss arenas
features.desc: Each realm ends in a sealed arena.

products.name: Amni-Life
products.tagline: A 3D memory map for the fragments of a life: seven views, local-first, encrypted sharing, photo and Takeout import.

features.name: Constellation
features.desc: A 3D graph of your life.

features.name: Timeline
features.desc: Your life laid out by year.

features.name: Globe
features.desc: Geo-tagged memories on a sphere.

features.name: Calendar
features.desc: A year-by-month grid.

products.name: Amni-Prayer
products.tagline: An interactive 3D map of the whole Catholic Bible: 35,817 verses, 64,497 cross-references, 17 layouts, Tandem reading.

features.name: Cross-reference graph
features.desc: Pick a verse and its connections glow gold.

features.name: Tandem mode
features.desc: Text, the 3D view and linked passages side by side.

features.name: Seventeen layouts
features.desc: Solar, golden ratio, double helix, cross and more.
